decisions.reason: The Blockaid verification request addresses an external wallet-security false positive and does not require any change to the FAQ content, including its anti-scam explanation.
Submitting the project to Blockaid does not alter the landing-page hero layout, sizing, or image placement.
The source requests Blockaid project verification but does not change any hero copy or messaging requirement.
Blockaid verification for a scam-warning false positive does not change the Transak provider, fiat payment flow, or wallet-provisioning behavior.
The security-warning remediation has no effect on prize eligibility, Chainlink VRF selection, or draw verification.
The Blockaid submission request does not resolve or modify the prize payout and claim workflow.
Project verification with Blockaid does not alter rewards for mints made without a valid referral code.
The source does not change NFT certificate availability, confirmation-email contents, or ebook-access links.
The Blockaid remediation action does not entail any update to landing-page mechanics or prize messaging.
External project verification does not change which owned NFTs must appear on the dashboard.
The security false-positive remediation does not affect referral commission or ticket accounting.
Blockaid project verification is separate from the NFT-ownership access policy and does not change who may decrypt or view the ebook.
